### Lincoln Electric Announces September 2026 Events With the Financial Community


September 1, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/573539267/files/doc_news/Lincoln-Electric-Announces-September-2026-Events-With-the-Financial-Community-2026.pdf)


CLEVELAND--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lincolnelectric.com%2F&esheet=54597428&newsitemid=20260901086523&lan=en-US&anchor=Lincoln+Electric+Holdings%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=1b8bad5cde49c5d955437ce61f2da292) , (Nasdaq: LECO) today announced participation in the following upcoming events with the financial community in the month of September:


**2026 Jefferies Global Industrials Conference** Thursday, September 10, 2026
8:50 am ET live webcast
New York, NY
Gabe Bruno, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer


**Morgan Stanley **14th Annual Laguna Conference**** Thursday, September 17, 2026
9:15 am PT (12:15 pm ET) live webcast
Dana Point, CA
Gabe Bruno, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer


**D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference** Thursday, September 24, 2026
10:30 am CT (11:30am ET) live webcast
Nashville, TN
Gabe Bruno, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer


Webcasts and replays can be accessed on our Investor Relations web site:[https://ir.lincolnelectric.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.lincolnelectric.com%2F&esheet=54597428&newsitemid=20260901086523&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.lincolnelectric.com&index=2&md5=df3dab90a1d980f2150309746c38a585) .


**About Lincoln Electric**


Lincoln Electric is a high-performance industrial machinery and technology leader who helps customers manufacture and maintain vital equipment and infrastructure. Lincoln Electric’s innovative solutions enable higher quality and productivity across a variety of processes including welding, cutting, brazing, machining, process automation, and field repair. The Company leverages proprietary technologies and expertise in materials science, power electronics, automation, and intelligent software to help customers build better and achieve resilience in their operations. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, Lincoln Electric is the essential ‘Linc’ that keeps the economy running. The Company operates 71 manufacturing and automation facilities across 20 countries and serves customers in over 160 countries. For more information about Lincoln Electric and its products and services, visit the Company’s website at[https://www.lincolnelectric.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lincolnelectric.com%2F&esheet=54597428&newsitemid=20260901086523&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lincolnelectric.com&index=3&md5=6e38d70561d2c49890901e647c78dbff) .
